# 2026-10-22 — re-check of headline numbers on the final pipeline

Re-run of the `9f25157` headline measurements on the final v1 wire
(LPC63 + gain stereo + LTP + rANS + LMS). Machine: i7-14650HX, 24
threads; `flq` = `target/release/flq.exe`, `-5` defaults, `-j` at all
cores unless noted.

## Frame size / history reset (47-file set, `--frame N`, all decodes verified)

Reference point is the largest allowed frame (262144 samples) — the
older report compared against a pre-v1 continuous-coding build that no
longer exists.

| frame_len | Output | vs 262144 | vs FLAC -8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 | 50.599% | +0.44 pp | 36/47 |
| 8192 | 50.377% | +0.22 pp | 45/47 |
| **16384 (default)** | **50.265%** | **+0.10 pp** | **46/47** |
| 32768 | 50.210% | +0.05 pp | 46/47 |
| 65536 | 50.182% | +0.02 pp | 46/47 |
| 262144 | 50.161% | — | 46/47 |

## Full WAV/AIFF set (148 files, 1572 MiB, defaults)

| | Result | (was `9f25157`) |
|---|---|---|
| Accepted / verified | 148/148 (WAV: data chunk byte-identical; AIFF: pcm_crc) | 148/148 |
| Output | **54.74%** (median 57.28%) | 55.75% / 58.02% |
| Encode | 80.4 s total, 19.6 MiB/s (incl. many small files) | 30.5 s / 51.6 MiB/s |
| Decode | 12.3 s total, parallel frames | 28.9 s single-threaded |
| Peak heap | enc ≤ 52.2 MiB; dec ≤ 26.2 MiB at `-j24`, 0.6 MiB at `-j1` | dec ≤ 0.8 MiB |
| Seek | `--range` 0.1 s in a 600 s file: 6–20 ms wall incl. process start | 9–23 ms |

Per-tool subsets of the same 148 (reference sizes from `out/results.csv`):
